scope: Original living large predatory fish anchored Sternberg whole skeleton; not a tarpon recolor or reused fish mesh.

anchors: Shelburne2020 primary comparative cranial study, X.audax text only

scale.basis: Artist nominal adult near reported14ft Sternberg specimen. Width, live flesh and exact posed bounds art, not original-specimen measurements.

pose: Straight neutral swimming, jaws nearly closed with only a narrow dark mouth seam; no swallowed prey, feeding violence or exposed skeleton. Paired fins slightly spread.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 subdued gray/olive/slate/tan palette values, not fossil pigment claim. No emissive eyes.
surface_profile.detail: Closed thin-solid fins, single-sided materials; no paper-thin DoubleSide planes. Selective facet/scale structure, no thousands of separate scales or detached bead objects.

coordinates.origin: Model centerline projected to lowest-body reference plane at Z0; neutral unsupported swimming pose, no stand. State exact bounds.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import, fixed numeric camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Inspect silhouette/body thickness and all fin placements before detail.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic for concrete ambiguity; no mandatory8 views in current scoped making.

scientific_limits: Whole skeleton is a prepared museum mount in plaster; restored edges and skeletal pose do not give exact flesh depth or fin-web margins. Fin positions reliable broad anchors, not a scan-copy.
Contained Gillicus is separate swallowed prey; do NOT convert its bones into extra Xiphactinus fins or body structures.

Shelburne2020 Figs1–2 are Megalops/tarpon comparison specimens, NOT approved Xiphactinus skull image anchors; explicitly exclude these rendered pages. Thesis supports important cranial differences, not tarpon cloning.

Quiet nearly closed mouth avoids unsupported exact tooth counts. A few understated anterior tooth hints optional only if integrated with source skull; no giant outside fangs or invented hanging fang curtain.
Color, scales, soft lip thickness and body cross-section artist inferred. No exact pigment, locomotion speed or feeding-mechanism claim.
No reuse of museum scans/3D models or copied photo textures.

morphology.obligation: Elongate powerful fish body with relatively deep blunt cranial region, broad gill-cover mass, tapering trunk and narrow caudal peduncle; not cylindrical pipe or huge spherical head.
morphology.source: Actual Sternberg whole mounted skeleton photo and thesis comparative text.

morphology.obligation: Short deep head with steep/upturned anterior mouth profile and robust lower jaw, moderate lateral eyes; mouth seam follows cranial outline. Do not lengthen snout to barracuda or project tarpon-like chin.
morphology.source: FHSU actual skull portion; Shelburne2020 discussion of short robust maxilla and caudally inflected anterior dentary.

morphology.obligation: One dorsal fin well back on body, one anal fin on rear underside; long swept paired pectorals directly behind head, smaller paired pelvics on belly, deep forked caudal fin with two pointed lobes. No adipose fin, second dorsal, armor or spiny dorsal ridge.
morphology.source: Actual mounted fins and thesis caudally positioned dorsal/deeply forked tail description.

morphology.obligation: Cohesive lowpoly fleshy exterior, restrained fine scale suggestion and subtle fin-ray ridges; do not expose rib cage or reproduce fossil cracks/plaster.
morphology.source: Living-body inference declared; skeletal reference only.

acceptance_obligations: Four exactGLB front/side/top/perspective: side confirms short deep head/upturned mouth and posterior dorsal/anal plus forked tail; top/front confirm realistic body/head width and both paired fin sets; perspective verifies integrated fin roots and no skeleton artifacts.
Count7 fins:2pectoral+2pelvic+1dorsal+1anal+1caudal. Swallowed prey must not create extra anatomy.
Do not use thesisFigs1–2 as Xiphactinus skull references, nor generic tarpon head template. No gaping theatrical jaws required.
Closed thin-solid fins, single-sided culling; two COMPLETE deterministic rebuilds with semantic digests; default helpers; source/export/validator/clean-import4view reports.
Independent morphology QA; full production8/GPU/scene/user acceptance separately unclaimed.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
